GPU 運算資源排程

GPU Compute Orchestration

自主研發 · 互動技術展示

回放單工作站的真實 CUDA 與 CPU 任務，並用合成佇列比較 FIFO 與回填。

建立專案需求 回放單工作站 CUDA 任務 技術圖解

產業問題與工程挑戰

共享運算環境若同時有多個工作，必須兼顧資源需求、等待順序與資源利用。 一個排在前方的大工作可能阻擋後方能先執行的小工作。提高利用率的同時，還要理解不同工作的等待代價。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

以隔離的實際排程器啟動兩個受控 CUDA 工作與一個 CPU 工作，保存相對時間、任務狀態和隔離佇列的 VRAM 取樣。另以固定的合成工作比較 FIFO 與回填。

成果

在測試的單 GPU 執行槽設定下，兩件 CUDA 工作依序執行，CPU 工作與第一件 CUDA 工作並行。兩件 CUDA 工作的程序級取樣峰值均為 286 MiB。

  • 可重現的單機排程試驗
  • 工作佇列、狀態與排程時間軸
  • 供選型討論的資源配置方式

驗證與證據

核對實跑開始與結束時間、退出碼和 VRAM 取樣。FIFO 與回填比較沿用合成工作與模擬刻度。

受控實跑回放

兩個 CUDA 任務與一個 CPU 任務

在一台具 24 GiB GPU 的工作站限制 GPU 併發為一。第二個 GPU 任務等第一個釋放執行槽，CPU 任務與第一個 GPU 任務並行。

Technical Note

GPU Compute Orchestration

Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Replay measured CUDA and CPU jobs on one workstation, and compare FIFO and backfill using a synthetic workload.

繁體中文 Plan a project Replay the measured single-workstation run Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

A shared compute environment must balance resource demands, queue order and resource usage when several jobs arrive together. A large job at the head of the queue can block smaller jobs that fit the currently available resources. A policy should make the waiting trade-offs visible.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

An isolated run of the real scheduler launched two controlled CUDA jobs and one CPU-only job, recording relative timestamps, job state and test-queue VRAM samples. A separate synthetic workload compares FIFO and backfill.

Outcome

Under a one-GPU-job limit, the two CUDA jobs ran in sequence while the CPU job overlapped the first. Sampled per-process VRAM peaked at 286 MiB for each CUDA job.

  • Reproducible single-machine scheduling experiment
  • Queue, job status and timeline
  • Resource configuration for engineering discussion

Validation and evidence

Verify recorded start and end times, exit codes and VRAM samples. FIFO and backfill comparisons use synthetic jobs and simulation ticks.

Controlled recorded run

Two CUDA jobs and one CPU job

Run on a workstation with a 24 GiB GPU and a one-GPU-job limit. The second GPU job waits for the first to release its slot while the CPU job runs alongside the first.

Project status and disclosure

Ownership and status
Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Independent single-workstation test with generated inputs. The run validates admission and overlap under the stated settings. Production throughput, multi-GPU scheduling and multi-user governance require separate validation.
